Huslyo123 的 ComfyUI 逼真工作流程

您是 ComfyUI 新手，想要创建令人惊叹的、逼真的 AI 图像，而又不想迷失在所有节点和设置中吗？本指南适合您。我将引导您完成我的个人工作流程，并在干净的 ComfyUI 安装上进行了测试。

每个步骤都通过屏幕截图、示例和提示进行解释。无论您是刚刚开始使用还是从 A1111 切换过来，此工作流程都将帮助您快速获得一致、高质量、逼真的结果。

更新：V3是最适合初学者且稳定的工作流程！使用那个

🔍Huslyo123 真实感工作流程是什么？

这是一个干净简单的ComfyUI 工作流程，设计用于大多数SDXL 检查站。它对初学者友好，但如果您想扩展到更高级的设置，它也是一个坚实的基础。

工作流程包括：

  • 2 面部细节师，一种用于整个头部，一种专门用于眼睛

  • 精心调整设置以获得清晰、真实的结果

  • 灵活的布局，易于调整和调整

  • 易于安装，没有奇怪或晦涩的节点，一切都是通过内置安装的自定义节点管理器

  • 谷物过滤器：为了增加真实感（仅在 V2 中。在 V3 中将它们替换为我的颗粒感 LoRA)

  • 升级器：获得更清晰、更真实的图像

如果您想快速获得出色的结果，或者将其用作您自己的逼真工作流程的起点，那么它是完美的选择。

想要训练自己角色洛拉– 一个适用于Instagram 风格的内容、Fanvue 或 OnlyFans?
在我的里面私人不和谐，我分享深入指南一步步引导您完成整个过程。

您还可以访问：
• 我的先进的Automatic1111逼真工作流程
• 数百个随时可用的提示最佳 (NSFW) 图像
• 仅限 Discord 的 LoRA
• 来自我的直接支持以及对您的人工智能工作的反馈
• 持续更新、奖励内容和惊喜

🧠 无论您是创作者还是只是好奇，我都会在这里分享我所知道的一切。

第 1 步：安装带有稳定性矩阵的稳定扩散（如果已安装，请跳过）

如果您尚未安装稳定扩散，请转到https://lykos.ai 并下载稳定性矩阵，一个免费的开源桌面应用程序。这与我个人使用的工具相同，我强烈推荐初学者使用它（非附属）。

为什么使用稳定性矩阵？
• 它会安装运行 Stable Diffusion 所需的一切：Python、Git、所需的库（如 numpy）等等，所有这些都具有正确的版本。
• 它使您的环境保持稳定且最新。
• 您可以轻松管理和共享模型、LoRA、嵌入和 VAE 文件舒适用户界面, 自动1111, 锻造和其他工具。

安装后，您只需单击一下即可添加 ComfyUI。

第2步：安装ComfyUI

里面稳定性矩阵，单击“+套餐”左侧菜单中的按钮并选择舒适用户界面从列表中。
点击安装并等待该过程完成。

就是这样。您现在已经有了一个干净的 ComfyUI 设置。

步骤 3：安装 ComfyUI 管理器

在安装管理器之前，请确保您已安装git安装。

  1. 从以下位置下载 Git：https://git-scm.com/downloads/win

  2. 运行安装程序。默认设置就完美了，点击即可下一步直到完成。

现在我们来安装舒适UI管理器:

  1. 转到您的 ComfyUI自定义节点文件夹。如果您通过稳定性矩阵安装，路径将类似于：

C:\Users\你的名字\稳定性矩阵\Data\Packages\ComfyUI\custom_nodes

  1. 单击文件夹窗口顶部的地址栏，输入 cmd，然后按输入在该位置打开终端。

  2. 在终端中，粘贴：

git 克隆 https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager comfyui-manager

  1. 重新启动 ComfyUI。

现在你会看到一个“经理”ComfyUI 内的选项卡。这使得直接在界面内安装和更新节点变得非常容易。

第 4 步：下载我的工作流程文件

在此页面上下载 .json 文件，名为：
Huslyo123 真实感工作流程 SDXL – ComfyUI [版本号]

然后：

  1. 启动ComfyUI（第一次可能需要一段时间，因为它会在后台设置所有内容）

  2. ComfyUI 打开后，拖放将我的 .json 文件放入画布中

  3. 您现在将看到我的完整工作流程。一些节点可能会出现红色，这很正常！

感谢舒适UI管理器，您现在可以单击“安装缺少的自定义节点”按钮在顶部。
然后点击“全部安装”并等待该过程完成。


一旦完成，重新启动ComfyUI。此步骤后启动 ComfyUI 可能需要更长的时间，有时第一次尝试时不会启动。如果需要，只需再次单击绿色的启动按钮即可。

第 5 步：安装 Checkpoint、VAE、LoRA 和 Eye Detailer

要正确运行此工作流程，您需要安装一些关键文件：检查点、VAE、LoRA 和眼睛细节模型。

🔹检查站
为获得最佳效果，请使用逼真的 SDXL 检查点。我个人推荐我自己的Huslyo现实主义XL （实验 V1），但如果您更喜欢其他东西，请尝试模拟疯狂或欲望，两者都很优秀。
将 .safetensors 文件放入：

C:\Users\你的名字\稳定性矩阵\Data\Models\StableDiffusion

🔹VAE（sdxl_vae.safetensors）
前往：https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/sdxl-vae/tree/main
单击下载图标下载名为 sdxl_vae.safetensors 的文件。

将其放入：

C:\Users\你的名字\稳定性矩阵\Data\Models\VAE

🔹洛拉
我总是用我的现实主义 洛拉 在此工作流程中。即使使用 HuslyoRealismXL，它也增加了额外的真实感。
您可以使用这个或您喜欢的任何其他 LoRA。将文件放入：

C:\Users\你的名字\稳定性矩阵\Data\Models\Lora

🔹眼部细节工具 (PitEyeDetailer)
SDXL 模特需要眼部护理师打造锐利、逼真的眼睛。我推荐：
PitEyeDetailer-v2-seg.pt

⚠️ Windows 可能会警告该文件不安全。我自己忽略了这一点，因为多次扫描表明它是安全的。

C:\Users\你的名字\Stability Matrix\Data\Packages\ComfyUI\models\ultralytics\bbox。

🔹Upscaler（仅限 V2）

如果您使用V2版本的工作流程。下载高档模型
https://huggingface.co/FacehugmanIII/4x_foolhardy_Remacri

放置文件在C:\Users\你的名字\稳定性矩阵\Data\Models\ESRGAN，或者如果您使用 ComfyUI 的独立版本，则在\ESRGAN文件夹。

✅你准备好了！

启动 ComfyUI，加载工作流程，您现在可以创建逼真的图像只需点击几下即可。

看看我的奇维人工智能简介，我发布过的地方2,700 多张图片– 每个都包含完整的提示，因此您可以在此工作流程中直接重新创建它们：

Huslyo123’s ComfyUI Photorealistic Workflow

Are you new to ComfyUI and want to create stunning, photorealistic AI images without getting lost in all the nodes and settings? This guide is for you. I’ll walk you through my personal workflow, tested on a clean ComfyUI install.

Every step is explained with screenshots, examples and tips. Whether you’re just starting out or switching from A1111, this workflow will help you get consistent, high-quality photorealistic results fast.

Update: V3 is the most beginner friendly and stable workflow! Use that one

🔍What is the Huslyo123 Photorealistic Workflow?

This is a clean and simpleComfyUI workflow, designed for use with mostSDXL checkpoints. It’s beginner-friendly, but also a solid base if you want to expand into more advanced setups.

The workflow includes:

  • 2 Face Detailers, one for the full head and one specifically for the eyes

  • Carefully tuned settings for sharp, realistic results

  • A flexible layout that’s easy to tweak and adapt

  • Easy to install, no weird or obscure nodes, everything is installed through the built-inCustom Nodes Manager

  • Grain filters: for added realism (only in V2. Replace them in V3 with myTouch of Grain LoRA)

  • Upscaler:for sharper and more realistic images

Perfect if you want to get great results fast, or use it as a starting point for your own photorealistic workflow.

✨ Want to create consistent character models, explore A1111 workflows, and get exclusive guides & tips? ->https://www.fanvue.com/huslyo123/fv-3

Curious what’s included? Full overview here → https://huslyo123.carrd.co/

Looking to train your owncharacter LoRA– one that works forInstagram-style content, Fanvue, or OnlyFans?
Inside myprivate Discord, I sharein-depth guidesthat walk you through the full process, step by step.

You’ll also get access to:
• Myadvanced Automatic1111 photorealistic workflow
• Hundreds of ready-to-use promptsfor the best (NSFW) images
• Discord-only LoRAs
• Direct support from meand feedback on your AI work
• Ongoing updates, bonus content, and surprises

🧠 Whether you're a creator or just curious, this is where I share everything I know.

Step 1: Install Stable Diffusion with Stability Matrix (skip if already installed)

If you don’t have Stable Diffusion installed yet, go tohttps://lykos.ai and downloadStability Matrix, a free and open-source desktop app. This is the same tool I personally use and I highly recommend it for beginners (not affiliated).

Why Stability Matrix?
• It installs everything you need to run Stable Diffusion: Python, Git, required libraries like numpy, and more,  all with the correct versions.
• It keeps your environment stable and up-to-date.
• You can easily manage and share models, LoRAs, embeddings, and VAE files betweenComfyUI, Automatic1111, Forge, and other tools.

Once installed, you’ll be ready to add ComfyUI in just one click.

Step 2: Install ComfyUI

InsideStability Matrix, click the“+ Packages”button in the left menu and selectComfyUIfrom the list.
ClickInstalland wait for the process to finish.

That’s it. You now have a clean ComfyUI setup.

Step 3: Install ComfyUI Manager

Before installing the manager, make sure you haveGitinstalled.

  1. Download Git from:https://git-scm.com/downloads/win

  2. Run the installer. The default settings are perfect, just clickNextuntil it's done.

Now let’s installComfyUI Manager:

  1. Go to your ComfyUIcustom_nodesfolder. If you installed via Stability Matrix, the path will look something like:

C:\Users\your-name\Stability Matrix\Data\Packages\ComfyUI\custom_nodes

  1. Click the address bar at the top of the folder window, type cmd, and pressEnterto open a terminal in that location.

  2. In the terminal, paste:

git clone https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager comfyui-manager

  1. Restart ComfyUI.

You’ll now see a“Manager”tab inside ComfyUI. This makes it super easy to install and update nodes directly inside the interface.

Step 4: Download My Workflow File

Download the .json file on this page called:
Huslyo123 Photorealistic Workflow SDXL – ComfyUI [version number]

Then:

  1. Start ComfyUI(this may take a while the first time, as it sets up everything in the background)

  2. Once ComfyUI is open,drag and dropmy .json file into the canvas

  3. You’ll now see my full workflow. Some nodes will likely show upin red, that’s normal!

Thanks toComfyUI Manager, you can now click the“Install missing custom nodes”button at the top.
Then click“Install All”and wait for the process to finish.


Once done,restart ComfyUI. Starting ComfyUI may take a bit longer after this step, and sometimes it won’t launch on the first try. Just click the green Launch button again if needed.

Step 5: Install Checkpoint, VAE, LoRA, and Eye Detailer

To run this workflow correctly, you’ll need to install a few key files: a checkpoint, a VAE, a LoRA, and an eye detailer model.

🔹Checkpoint
For best results, use a photorealistic SDXL checkpoint. I personally recommend my ownHuslyoRealismXL (experimental V1), but if you'd prefer something else, tryAnalogMadnessorLustify, both are excellent.
Place the .safetensors file into:

C:\Users\your-name\Stability Matrix\Data\Models\StableDiffusion

🔹VAE (sdxl_vae.safetensors)
Go to:https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/sdxl-vae/tree/main
Download the file named sdxl_vae.safetensors by clicking the download icon.

Place it in:

C:\Users\your-name\Stability Matrix\Data\Models\VAE

🔹LoRA
I always use myTouch-of-Realism LoRA in this workflow. It adds that extra layer of realism, even with HuslyoRealismXL.
You can use this or any other LoRA you like. Place the file in:

C:\Users\your-name\Stability Matrix\Data\Models\Lora

🔹Eye Detailer (PitEyeDetailer)
SDXL models need an eye detailer for sharp, realistic eyes. I recommend:
PitEyeDetailer-v2-seg.pt

⚠️ Windows might warn that this file is unsafe. I ignore this myself because multiple scans show it’s safe.

C:\Users\your-name\Stability Matrix\Data\Packages\ComfyUI\models\ultralytics\bbox.

🔹Upscaler (V2 only)

If you use the V2 version of the workflow. Download the upscale model
https://huggingface.co/FacehugmanIII/4x_foolhardy_Remacri

Place the fileinC:\Users\your-name\Stability Matrix\Data\Models\ESRGAN, or if you use a standalone version of ComfyUI, in the\ESRGANfolder.

✅You’re ready!

Start ComfyUI, load the workflow, and you’re now able to createphotorealistic imagesin just a few clicks.

Want examples?
Check out myCivitAI profile, where I’ve posted over2,700+ images– each with full prompts included so you can recreate them directly in this workflow:

👉 https://civitai.com/user/Huslyo123
